name: Sugarcane Vinegar Fish Fry
instructions: 1. Clean the fish slices thoroughly and pat them dry.
2. In a bowl, whisk together the sugarcane vinegar, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, cumin, pepper, and salt to create a smooth marinade.
3. Coat the fish slices evenly with the marinade and let them rest for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
4. Mix the rice flour and semolina on a plate.
5. Press each marinated fish piece into the flour mixture, ensuring a thin, even crust.
6. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
7. Shallow fry the fish for 3-4 minutes on each side until the exterior is crispy and the flesh is opaque and cooked through.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh curry leaves.
description: This dish is a testament to the coastal heritage of the region, where the use of sugarcane vinegar—a local specialty—provides a unique, mild sweetness and sharp tang that cuts through the richness of the fresh catch. It is a popular preparation in Daman, reflecting the fusion of Portuguese-influenced techniques with local spice profiles.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
